body:
I’ll be part of the amazing Revolutionary Love 2017 conference hosted at Middle Collegiate Church April 28-30. I’m really looking forward to this gathering of spiritual activists from around the country. I hope you’ll come! If you register asap, you can use this code for a 25% (!) discount:  SPR2017.

 We’ll be talking about “disruptive ethics to dismantle racism,” and the list of speakers is truly once-in-a-lifetime. I hope to see many of you there – in just a few weeks.
